title: Lift the split finite-cover product map to internal modules
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative monoid object in condensed abelian groups, with its scheme coefficient rings and inverse-image comparison as in [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-point-pullback]. Use the internal module categories and adjunctions of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let p:U\to X, weakly-etale g:Y\to X, n, t_j:Y\to U and t_j p=g satisfy the coproduct hypothesis of [lem-weil-pbc-split-proetale-abelian-product-map]. For every internal Lambda_U-module N, the canonical linear map g^*p_*N\to\prod_j t_j^*N is an isomorphism, with j-th component the inverse-image composition comparison followed by inverse image of the p-adjunction counit.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 095B, split finite-cover computation; agent pro-etale and internal-coefficient variant.

proof.text: Reuse the private moduleUnit_forget_inv lemma of ProfinitePointPullback through proof-only import all. Apply the abelian hom equivalence and both right triangle equations to obtain the analogous counit equation, without reproving either unit compatibility lemma.

Combine that counit equation with composition coherence of the forgetful inverse-image isomorphism. Naturality shows each displayed linear sheet map forgets to its abelian counterpart. First eliminate the sheet equality t composed with p equals g, reducing the equality transports to identities before the diagram calculation.

The forgetful functor preserves products. The product comparison and the product of the sheet forgetful isomorphisms conjugate the underlying module product map to the abelian product map. Apply its invertibility and reflection of isomorphisms by module forgetful functors.

lean.statement:
theorem splitProEtaleModuleProductMap_isIso
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X U Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X)
    (g : Y ⟶ X) [WeaklyEtale g]
    (n : ℕ) (t : Fin n → (Y ⟶ U)) (w : ∀ j, t j ≫ p = g)
    (hc : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback p g)
      (fun j ↦ pullback.lift (t j) (𝟙 Y) (by simpa using w j)))))
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ U)) :
    let a := fun j ↦ (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar Λ) (w j))).symm ≪≫
      upperStarComp Λ (t j) p
    IsIso (Pi.lift (fun j ↦
      (a j).hom.app ((lowerStar Λ p).obj N) ≫
        (upperStar Λ (t j)).map ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ p).counit.app N)))
